insights: Hero employs floating 3D illustrations with hover-triggered CTAs, creating a playful, interactive spatial rhythm that breaks from strict grid containment.
Cream (#fcfbf7) and charcoal (#2b2627) brand palette establishes a warm, tactile feel; generous letter-spacing and light font weights enhance readability.

Desktop layout constrains content to a max-width mirroring viewport aspect ratio (1440 / 960), creating a letterboxed, art-directed frame. Mobile collapses to single column with horizontal marquee for props.
